import pdfplumber
from openpyxl import Workbook

PDF_PATH = "/workspace/invoice_sample.pdf"
XLSX_PATH = "/workspace/invoice_text.xlsx"

# Extract text from the first page
with pdfplumber.open(PDF_PATH) as pdf:
    first_page = pdf.pages[0]
    text = first_page.extract_text()

# Write each line of text into a separate row in the Excel file
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Page 1 Text"
ws.append(["Line", "Text"])  # header row

if text:
    for i, line in enumerate(text.split("\n"), start=1):
        ws.append([i, line])
else:
    ws.append([1, "(No text found on page 1)"])

wb.save(XLSX_PATH)
print(f"✅ Extracted {len(text.split(chr(10))) if text else 0} lines from page 1")
print(f"   Saved to: {XLSX_PATH}")
